svg.title: Naming and the ROS boundary
svg.desc: Three layers: ROS messages and common_ros keep their names; a boundary inside the scheduler translates them; scheduler and planner_core code uses the new names and internal types.

g.text: Proposed in doc 02, Naming and the ROS boundary; the full list of names is doc 04. File paths are under scheduler/include/scheduler/ (headers) and scheduler/src/ (sources).

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Renames stay inside scheduler and planner_core. common_ros names are translated by aliases in one header; messages the scheduler builds or keys maps with become internal types at the edge. DiscreteGarageState and the event payloads still
